- No error middleware to catch and handle exceptions

- No Content Security Policy (CSP)

- No structured logging for security monitoring

- Use validation middleware like express-validator
- Validate and sanitize all user inputs
- Implement strict schema validation for parameters

- Implement global error handling middleware
- Use try-catch for async operations
- Return generic error messages to clients

- Use Helmet middleware to set secure headers

- Set appropriate limits per IP or authentication token

- Limit payload size to prevent memory exhaustion
- Set reasonable limits for different endpoints

- Implement structured logging with Winston or Bunyan
- Log security-relevant events (failed requests, errors)
- Ensure logs don't contain sensitive data

- Sanitize user inputs to prevent XSS and injection attacks
